name: Unrelated work and acknowledgement do not certify a steer; explicit start clears its deadline
Finite holds expire, blanket grants refuse, and pending decisions stay visible
Escalated A cannot suppress new B, with A open or resolved before polling; unchanged B deduplicates
Configured persistent wait survives unrelated resolution without a missed checkpoint
Missed checkpoint reports current generation; inspected progress clears it and a new generation reports independently
A returned validation result stays overdue until its owner consumes it
Successive notification exits refresh and record the watcher beacon
